Refulgent Copper
5 yd range

Copper veins have long populated Azeroth. Through a combination of advances in Mining techniques and copper veins bathing in magical energies, the newly-dubbed Refulgent Copper is quickly becoming an essential metal in Quel'Thalas.

Discovery: Midnight Gathering Nodes
